svg.text: SEAN’S STATION, alone on this wall. Seen in S02 — and in beats 4, 12 and 13, which makes it the film’s most-used angle.
filing cabinet 0.5–4′ · 5′h · boxes and a tired plant on top
SEAN’S DESK 10–17′ · 2.5′h · he sits facing north
three monitors 10.9–16.1′ · 1.6′h @ 2.5′ · quiet lines of code
corkboard + shelf 10.6–16.4′ · 3.4′h @ 4.6′ · notes, binders, trailing plant, cable run
SHIP IT bell 18–19′ · 1′h @ 6.4′ · bracket + pull cord · hollow at beat 9, earned at 17
confetti cannon 19.6–21′ · 1.6′h · tripod · misfires at beat 9
storage bench 22–25.5′ · 2.2′h · boxes, coat rack above
CLAUDE’S NOOK at the north end, the doorway, then CODEX’S RACK at the south end. Seen in S03 (NW corner) and S04 (SW corner).
supply desk 0.4–2.4′ · 2.6′h · jar of pens, stapler
PAPER TOWER 2.7–3.9′ · 5.6′h · flagged, leaning, the hero prop
SERVER RACK 11.5–12.6′ · 7.4′h · status lights, loose cabling
THE CODE WALL 13.1–15.6′ · 2.6′h @ 4.2′ · M2 beat 6 · scrolling code
GROK’S DARTBOARD at the north end, then THE CRT, then the moodboard wrapping in. Seen in S06 (NE corner) and S07.
side table 0.4–2.6′ · 2.2′h · crushed cans, a mug
DARTBOARD 2.2–3.9′ · 1.7′h @ 3.8′ · face clean, darts in the WALL around it
THE HOLE 0–2′ · 6.4′h · M2 beat 8 · the rocket leans out
THE CRT 10.7–12.9′ · 2.5′h @ 6.5′ · ONE fixture · bracket + cable down
GEMINI’S MOODBOARD, long. Seen in S05, and its west end appears at frame-LEFT of S04.
GEMINI’S MOODBOARD 6–22′ · 6.6′h @ 1.6′ · ~50 taped product and mascot concepts
string lights 6.4–21.6′ · 0.4′h @ 8.4′ · swagged above the board
board wraps SE 22–26′ · 6.6′h @ 1.6′ · round the corner
All four walls unrolled, flat, at one scale. Every fixture has one wall, one left-to-right position and one height.
A corner plate is a CROP OF A WALL — or, for S03 and S06, of two walls meeting. Two plates can no longer contradict each other.
RED = Movement 2, drawn now so no later beat has to invent a fixture the room never had.
Eye level 5′6″ is the horizon every plate sits on. The CRT sill at 6′6″ is the number both earlier CRT plates got wrong — one had it near the ceiling, one at shelf height.
